# YourGP@Lyneham

> General practice in Lyneham, Canberra — Genuine Care, Clinical Excellence.

YourGP@Lyneham is a 4-room general practice located in Lyneham, a suburb of Canberra in the Australian Capital Territory. It is the original YourGP location and part of the YourGP network of independent practices (Crace, Denman Prospect, and Lyneham). The practice offers comprehensive general practice services including skin cancer checks, minor procedures, chronic disease management, and preventive care. The practice is AGPAL accredited and is a teaching practice affiliated with the Australian National University. YourGP is actively recruiting GPs, nurses, and admin team members across 3 clinics with 33 consulting rooms, serving 30,000+ patients per year.

## Key Information

- **Address**: 62 Brigalow Street, Lyneham ACT 2602 (next to Tilley's cafe)
- **Phone**: (02) 6109 0000
- **Fax**: (02) 6109 0001
- **Hours**: Monday to Thursday 8:00am–6:00pm, Friday 8:00am–12:00pm
- **Booking**: Online via [HotDoc](https://www.hotdoc.com.au/medical-centres/lyneham-ACT-2602/yourgp-crace-lyneham/doctors) or by phone
- **Billing**: Private billing. Medicare rebates processed on the day. Not bulk billed.
- **New patients**: Welcome
- **After hours**: CALMS (1300 422 567) or Healthdirect (1800 022 222)

## Services

- Children's Health and Childhood Immunisations
- Chronic Disease Management (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, osteoarthritis, chronic kidney disease, autoimmune diseases)
- Driver's Medicals
- Men's Health
- Mental Health (care plans, referrals to psychologists)
- Minor Procedures (implanon, IUD insertion, skin cancer removal, ingrown toenails, tongue tie)
- Musculoskeletal
- Travel Vaccinations (yellow fever available at Denman and Crace)
- Skin Checks
- Vasectomy (Dr John Deery — initial consult at Lyneham, procedure at Crace; see canberravasectomy.com.au)
- Women's Health (pap smears, contraception, antenatal and postnatal care)
- Workers Compensation
- Allied Health: 4Cyte Pathology next door, nursing services

- [Canberra Vasectomy](https://www.canberravasectomy.com.au) — Dr John Deery, no-scalpel vasectomy
- [YourSkinCBR](https://www.yourskincbr.com.au) — Skin cancer specialist GPs at Crace and Denman
